ja.title: AI解析の正答率は何を確かめているか。scBenchの公開採点を読む
ja.summary: scBenchの差次的発現・QC課題の数値条件を実行確認。DEG数と遺伝子集合、同じ集計値と異なる理由を分け、合格が支持する範囲を検討する。
ja.seo_title: scBenchの正答率と単一細胞解析の採点
ja.seo_description: scBenchの公開採点器と独自コードを9ケースで照合。DEG数の一致が遺伝子集合の一致を保証しないことと、QC集計から理由を特定できないことを具体例で調べる。

en.title: What does AI analysis accuracy verify? Reading scBench's public grading rules
en.summary: Executed checks of two public scBench numeric conditions distinguish DEG counts from gene-set agreement, and QC summaries from the reasoning behind them.
en.seo_title: What scBench accuracy verifies in single-cell analysis
en.seo_description: Nine checks of public scBench grading conditions separate DEG counts from gene-set agreement and QC summaries from analytical reasoning.
